_note: Street performance, devotion rites and meditation done in person on the street map (systems/performing.js, ui/mapTasks/performTasks.js). Busking acts: pick a pitch, perform timed sets (setSeconds, real seconds = game minutes) while folk within 'pull' tiles drift over; anyone standing within 'listen' tiles during a set counts. The crowd a town should give is expectedPerCrowd × the town's crowd multiplier (data/earlyJobs.json busking). Glyphs are ui/icons.js names.

juggling.say: Find a pitch, then juggle set after set. Each set draws more of the street. Fumble and they drift off.

singing.say: Find a pitch and sing. Choose songs that suit the hour: hymns for the morning, ballads by day, drinking songs at night.

storytelling.say: Find a pitch and tell a tale in parts. Listeners stay to hear the end. Don't give them the same kind of turn twice running.

fortune_telling.say: Walk up to the passers-by marked for you and read their fortunes. Look for the tell: hands, clothes, bearing. A reading that fits them earns a coin.

preaching.say: Preach from the church steps or the square. Stir them up, but not into a fright: keep the fervour high without tipping it over.

beats.label: The wolves close in on the camp…
The bridge gives way beneath the hero…
The bishop's mule eats the bishop's hat…
The miller mistakes the duke for a sack of flour…
The old soldier never came home…
She waited at the harbour for forty years…
A door opens in the hillside where no door was…
The stars spell out a name…
Their eyes meet across the burning hall…

tones.label: The promise of the life to come

tells.farmer: Earth under the nails, a sunburnt neck.
tells.merchant: A fat purse and a quick eye on yours.
tells.guard: A scar on the knuckles, a hand that rests on a hilt.
tells.priest: Ink-stained fingers and a worn string of beads.
tells.villager: Patched sleeves, a ring on the finger, a glance toward home.
tells.noble: Rings on every finger and a bored look.
tells.traveler: Dust to the knees and a pack that has seen roads.

fortunes.text: The rains will be kind to your fields this year.
A long road ends with a heavy purse.
A blade hangs over you, but your arm is the stronger.
Someone at home is thinking of you this very hour.
A great house will fall, and yours will rise.
You'll be taller than your father, and twice as clever.
A stranger's coin will change your luck.
Love waits at the next well you drink from.

busking.readingAsk: {name} the {type} holds out a palm. ({tell}) What do you see?

lines.pitchSet: You set out your hat at the {pitch}.
lines.setDone: {n} stopped to watch. Coins clink in the hat.
lines.drop: You fumble a club! A few drift off.
lines.askSong: What will you sing? (The bells say it is {hour}.)
lines.askBeat: What happens next in the tale?
lines.askTone: How will you preach? (The crowd's fervour: {fervor}.)
lines.beatRepeat: They've had that already. It falls flat.
lines.beatFresh: A fresh turn. They lean in.
lines.songOff: Odd choice for the hour; a few drift off.
lines.fervorCold: They shuffle their feet. The sermon is cold.
lines.fervorSweet: Amens ring out. They are with you.
lines.fervorFrightened: Too much! They back away in fright.
lines.readFits: "That's it exactly!" A coin for your trouble.
lines.readMisses: They frown, unconvinced, and toss you a copper.

say.church: Light a candle at the church door, walk the circuit of stations around it, then kneel at the steps.
say.holy: Light a candle at the shrine, walk the pilgrims' circuit, then kneel.
say.wayside: There is no church here. Light a candle at the square, walk a circuit of the town, then kneel.

lines.station: Pause and pray at the station ({i} of {n})
lines.kneel: Kneel at the steps and pray
lines.disturbed: {name} brushes past and breaks your prayer.
lines.candleLit: The candle catches. You begin the circuit.

say.field: Find a quiet spot away from the bustle and sit still a while. Passers-by will break your focus.
say.holy: Find a quiet spot at this holy place and sit still a while.

spots.label: Sit in the quiet at the edge of town

lines.sitting: You settle and close your eyes.
lines.disturbed: {name} passes close by. Your focus slips.
lines.broke: You got up. The stillness is broken.
